fallback_execution_policy: The control plane produces an ordered fallback plan only. Runtime authority, entitlements, privacy, budget and availability gates remain separate and can contract or reject execution.
credential_policy: API keys, tokens, secrets and credentials remain in existing provider-specific storage/migration paths and are removed from Settings projections.
compatibility_note: Pass 6 does not rewrite existing Retriever provider credential persistence. It adds a company-aware control projection and safe update plan around the retained providerConfigs path.
